name: Regbase API (v1)
description:
JSON:API surface for warehouse entities and the entity change feed.

Responses use `application/vnd.api+json`. CORS allows any origin.

Entity and change endpoints require an organization API key in the
`Authorization: Bearer` header. Create keys in your Regbase account
settings.

Entity resources lift the warehouse `type` to the JSON:API resource `type`
(for example `legislation` or `person`) and spread remaining fields into
`attributes`. Empty snapshots fall back to resource type `entity`.

Merged entities are followed to the surviving canonical id (up to 5 hops).

### Field contract

GFFS filters and returned attributes are limited to:

`type, title, name, displayDate, jurisdiction, localIdentifier, localType, authority, status`

`type` is the JSON:API resource type, not an attribute. `changedKeys` on
change resources is intersected with this set plus `texts`. Entity responses
also include `texts` with Public Text IDs and downloadable renditions.
